import { expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { extractHeading } from '../../src/core/d7n-heading/helpers.js'

it.each([
	['### `Widget`', 'Widget'],
	['### `Widget<T>`', 'Widget'],
	['###   `Widget`   ', 'Widget'],
	['### **`Widget`**', 'Widget'],
	['### [`Widget`](target)', 'Widget'],
	['### Bind a `Widget` to a transport', undefined],
	['### `Widget` and `Alias`', undefined],
	['### `Widget` ` `', undefined],
	['### Classes', undefined],
])('reads the entity boundary in %s', (input, expected) => {
	if (input === undefined) throw new Error('heading input is required')
	expect(extractHeading(input)).toBe(expected)
})
